name: River Development Agent Production Execution Authority Orchestration Integration
objective: Establish a deterministic, fail-closed, non-executing production integration boundary that consumes the trusted DEV-322 production execution authority composition and supplies its preserved authority evidence into the existing DEV-319 governed operation-execution authorization orchestration boundary, without creating, upgrading, synthesizing, or broadening authorization and without executing repository operations.
requirements: Consume an existing trusted and ready DEV-322 production execution authority composition foundation.
Require DEV-322 composition state to be PRODUCTION_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_COMPOSED and require predecessor blockers to be absent before progression.
Preserve requested mode, human authorization, repository authorization, approved scope, approval evidence, provenance, and all relevant authority boundaries supplied by DEV-322.
Integrate DEV-322 production authority composition with the existing DEV-319 governed operation-execution authorization orchestration contract only through explicitly compatible existing inputs.
Do not treat requested apply mode as authorization.
Do not create, upgrade, synthesize, infer, or broaden execution authorization.
Do not broaden approved execution scope.
Fail closed when DEV-322 authority evidence cannot be mapped exactly into the existing governed authorization orchestration input contract.
Fail closed when required human authorization, repository authorization, approval evidence, approved scope, or other required predecessor evidence is absent or invalid.
Preserve the separation between production authority composition, authorization acquisition, authorization consumption, operational executor admission, and actual operation execution.
Return deterministic evidence describing whether production authority was accepted for governed orchestration progression.
DEV-323 must not itself execute a repository operation.
DEV-323 must not itself invoke arbitrary shell execution, network execution, commit, push, deployment, secret access, or uncontrolled external side effects.
DEV-323 must not bypass or weaken the existing DEV-317, DEV-318, DEV-319, operational executor entry, or downstream controlled execution boundaries.
No production caller modification is authorized by this initial specification-only phase.
safetyInvariants: Requested apply mode is never authorization.
DEV-323 cannot broaden approved execution scope.
DEV-323 cannot independently authorize operational executor entry.
DEV-323 cannot independently execute repository mutation.
DEV-323 cannot bypass governed authorization acquisition or consumption.
DEV-323 cannot bypass operational executor integration authorization.
No repository mutation or external side effect occurs inside DEV-323.
outOfScope: Direct command or arbitrary shell execution.
Commit, push, deployment, or secret access.
Creation or broadening of approved execution scope.
Modification of production callers before a separately evidenced integration seam is inspected and approved.
nextStep: Implement and test the narrow DEV-323 composition boundary. DEV-323 must accept already-built DEV-322 production authority composition evidence and independently supplied existing DEV-319 governed operation-execution authorization orchestration input; it must never derive, manufacture, upgrade, or synthesize OPERATION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED from DEV-322 production authority evidence.
